title: The Unseen Truth: In the Age of AI
author: Recovery
description:
What if the video you watched never happened? What if the voice of someone you love was generated by a machine? And what if a photograph that seemed to prove everything was nothing more than a collection of artificial pixels?

Welcome to The Unseen Truth, a thought-provoking podcast exploring one of the most disturbing questions of our technological age: can we still trust our own eyes?

Artificial intelligence is transforming the way we create and experience digital content. Images can be generated from simple descriptions, voices can be imitated, and realistic videos can depict people doing things they have never done. As these technologies become more sophisticated, the boundary between reality and fabrication grows increasingly difficult to recognize.

Across two compelling episodes, we explore how AI-generated deception works, why the human brain is vulnerable to convincing visual evidence, and how misinformation can influence our beliefs, relationships, and decisions.

But this series goes beyond technology. It examines the psychological consequences of living in a world where seeing is no longer the same as knowing. When almost anything can be fabricated, how do we decide what deserves our trust?

Because the greatest danger may not be that we believe every lie, but that we eventually stop believing the truth.

Our impartial, fact-based reporting wins worldwide praise and respect. It is our unique brand of #journalism that the world has come to rely on.

We are reshaping global media and constantly working to strengthen our reputation as one of the world's most respected #news and #CurrentAffairs channels.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: Called Out with Ashley Key
author: Christian Broadcasting Network
description: CALLED OUT is a podcast exploring what it truly looks like to follow God’s calling in everyday life. Through authentic conversations with creatives, entrepreneurs, ministry leaders, and everyday people, we uncover the journeys, challenges and moments of faith that have shaped their calling and how they’re using their gifts to make a meaningful impact on the world around them.

title: Directed By:
author: Griffin Knittel
description: I'm Griffin, and I love movies too much, so I had to start a podcast about 'em.

title: The Leadership Lab
author: Bamboo Pod
description: Hosted by award-winning leader, author and advisor Dale Botting, The Leadership Lab draws on his 50 years of experience across business, government and leadership. Each week, Dale explores a different arena of leadership through conversations with guests

title: Unhinged: One Star Reviews
author: Adrie Lopez Mackay
description:
This is Unhinged where we discuss one star reviews of famous places, landmarks and destinations around the world. 


My name's Adrie and as an expat living in Vietnam like everyone else, I love travelling. But a business or landmark is never far away from the dreaded one star review.


We're going to read our reviews, then guess the place first and then decide if the reviewer is truly unhinged, semi hinged, or hinged.


Unhinged means a mentally unbalanced, deranged, or behaving in an extremely irrational and out of control manner. We've all read an unhinged one star review.

title: The Hypercube Energy Podcast
author: Hypercube
description:
The Hypercube Energy Podcast explores the application of technology, data and AI across the energy sector.

In the fast-moving energy landscape, organisations of all sizes need to understand and adopt emerging tech to tackle complex problems, identify new areas of innovation and capitalise on opportunity.

What should an energy technology strategy look like?

How do we identify what problems to solve first?

What innovations are being made in the industry?

These are the questions that host Adam Sroka seeks to answer on this show.

In each episode, he sits down with tech experts and business leaders from the energy sector to understand exactly how they are solving energy-specific data challenges today.

You can learn more about Hypercube - Energy Technology Partner at wearehypercube.com

Join the Beyond Energy Community: wearehypercube.com/join-the-community/

title: True crime podcast
author: SC17 SC17
description:
True Crime Podcast

Explore real criminal cases, unsolved mysteries, shocking investigations, and extraordinary stories from around the world. Discover the facts behind the headlines, uncover hidden details, and examine the evidence in compelling narratives that reveal the complex realities of crime and justice.

Real Cases. Hidden Truths. Unanswered Questions.

Become a supporter of this podcast: https://www.spreaker.com/podcast/true-crime-podcast--7478953/support.

title: The Field
author: dtcvsu@samiahrafnirob.com
description:
The Field tells the true stories behind the greatest discoveries in physics. Each episode, host Nirob takes one phenomenon, one experiment, or one theory — Galileo's falling bodies, Newton's gravity, the double-slit experiment, Einstein's E=mc², the search for the Higgs boson — and rebuilds it: the physicists who chased it, the experiment that tested it, the moment of breakthrough, and the world it made.

From the atom to the expanding universe, from radioactivity to relativity, from the uncertainty principle to the first image of a black hole, The Field is about the relentless human effort to understand the universe — how ideas are tested, how theories are overturned, and why the laws of physics are among the greatest achievements of the human mind. Meticulously researched, honest about what is documented and what is still debated. Clean and suitable for all ages. A new story every week

title: If Bibles Could Talk
author: If Bible Could Talk
description:
This isn't just about reading the Bible. It's about understanding it, reflecting on it, and applying its wisdom to real life.

 Ads and Sponsorship - onpointstudio45@gmail.com

If Bibles Could Talk = Ancient stories. Timeless Wisdom. A better way to live.

title: METAtation
author: Beolty
description:
This podcast captures a specific tradition of meditation with an incredible depth to it. It was made for and exercised by the ruling class. In more modern terms, it's a meditation for leaders, the affluent, the privileged.


I call it a meditation for the elite as it cascades down from them.


Most forms of meditation seek to give the everyday person balance in the present moment. The meditation for the elite seeks to enable them to choreograph the results of meditation exercised by the people within their influence. Much like governments seek to choreograph their nations.


Through this podcast, we're looking past the points of view of meditation and are returning it to factory settings. From this central position, we'll push open both gates with a thrust to liberate meditation's full potential and enable it to become…as effortless as breathing.

Welcome to METAtation.

title: Economy & Finance
author: Quidas Quidas
description:
Podcast Description — Global Economy & Finance

Welcome to Global Economy & Finance, your source for insights into the world of money, business, and economic change.

Explore global economic trends, financial markets, personal finance, investing, entrepreneurship, inflation, wealth creation, and the forces shaping the world economy. Through clear explanations and engaging storytelling, we break down complex financial topics to help you understand how money works and how economic decisions affect everyday life.



Become a supporter of this podcast: https://www.spreaker.com/podcast/economy-finance--7478786/support.

title: GREAT ABYSS
author: GREAT ABYSS
description:
Welcome to The Great Abyss, your atmospheric archive dedicated to unearthing the profoundest mysteries of the universe and the hidden chapters of human history.
​If you find yourself captivated by the vast, enigmatic void of space, the secrets of deep time, and the artifacts that hint at forbidden knowledge, you have arrived at your new intellectual sanctuary. This channel is for the curious, the dreamers, and those who seek to understand the unknowable.
​In a setting like a forgotten, gaslit study filled with esoteric tomes and complex contraptions, we don't just recount tales; we conduct forensic examinations. Each episode is a careful decryption of a cosmic signal, an analysis of a high-profile historical enigma, or an exploration of inexplicable phenomena. We delve into theories on black holes and the nature of dark matter, decipher ancient, forgotten texts, investigate inexplicable disappearances, and explore the tantalizing hints of lost advanced knowledge.

title: The Blueprint
author: aqymmw@samiahrafnirob.com
description:
The Blueprint tells the true stories behind the world's greatest structures. Each episode, host Nirob takes one building, one bridge, or one feat of engineering — the Great Pyramid, the dome of the Pantheon, the Eiffel Tower, the Brooklyn Bridge, the Panama Canal, the Burj Khalifa — and rebuilds it: the architects and engineers who designed it, the labour and invention that raised it, the disasters and doubts it survived, and the world it shaped.

From the arenas of Rome to the cathedrals of the Middle Ages, from the skyscraper race to the unfinished cathedral of Gaudí, from dams that tamed rivers to towers that pierce the sky, The Blueprint is about the astonishing human will to build — how structures are designed, how they stand, and why they say more about a civilisation than any document. Meticulously researched, honest about what is documented and what is legend. Clean and suitable for all ages. A new story every week

title: Grimm on the Rocks
author: Edward Grimm
description: Strong opinions. Hard questions. Room to be wrong. Edward Grimm takes on politics, media, and the motives behind the headlines—with evidence, humor, and a willingness to challenge his own side. Featuring full episodes of Grimm on the Rocks and The Distillation: straight news, with a twist. An American History Studio production.

title: Women worth watching
author: laurapaynephoto
description:
Women worth watching is where bold business owners and women reinventing their second act share real stories behind the spotlight.
Hosted by Laura Payne, Portrait Photographer and founder of the ”26 women to watch” project, each episode goes beyond the photo to uncover the grit, growth and guts behind women building something new - at every stage of life.

title: Juice Box Friends

description: Follow four friends in the pursuit of real life lasting friendships.

title: Brief Case
author: Brief Case
description:
Welcome to Brief Case — your ultimate destination for deep dives into the darkest mysteries, unsolved enigmas, and gripping tales from the shadows. 
​Here, we open the files that others leave closed, examining the details, exploring the unknown, and bringing untold stories to light. If you have a passion for true crime, psychological mysteries, and atmospheric investigations, pull up a chair at the wooden desk, subscribe, and join us as we unlock the truth one case at a time.

title: The Athlete Effect™
author: Bonnie Bernstein
description: Once an athlete, always an athlete. Did you know 94% of female C-suite executives played sports? The Athlete Effect™ explores how sports build leadership, resilience, discipline, and confidence that fuel success long after the final whistle.Hosted by Emmy-winning sports journalist and former Division I gymnast Bonnie Bernstein, the show features athletes-turned-leaders across business, sports, media, medicine, entertainment, and tech.Featured guests include:Cathy Engelbert — WNBA CommissionerDominique Dawes — Olympian, entrepreneur & investorGinger Zee — ABC News Chief MeteorologistJessica Mendoza — ESPN analyst & OlympianKit Hoover — Host, Access HollywoodKristyn Cook — State Farm CMOMolly Battin — The Home Depot CMODr. Theresa Williamson — NeurosurgeonVernice “Fly Girl” Armour — First Black female combat pilot, U.S. militaryThe Athlete Effect™ features full conversations from "Power Players" on The Champion’s Edge on ABC, as well as podcast exclusive guests. Download and follow The Athlete Effect™ for more.

author: baruchhorowitzj
description: Jewish children's stories of tzadikim and chazal to inspire children and adults.

title: Projectx to GrowUp
author: B_Project
description:
Listen. Reflect. Grow. B_Project is a podcast about becoming the best version of yourself.
Through deep conversations, practical insights, and real stories, we explore how intentional listening can transform the way you think, feel, and live. Whether it’s personal growth, mindset shifts, emotional intelligence, or building better habits, every episode is designed to help you grow up and grow into your highest self. If you’re ready to stop just existing and start evolving, press play. Listen to grow up.
Grow into your best self.

title: Journeying
author: with host Dr Dee Duffy
description: Journeying… with researcher and host Dr Dee Duffy, a podcast exploring everyday lives and human experiences.  Connecting with real humans and their passage on this journey, so far. Conversations to help us think critically about the seemingly mundane events of ordinary life. Ideas to inspire us to live more consciously. Lifehacks to motivate us on our own journey of self-discovery.

title: Inside the Fashion Cosmos - Where brands, technology, and ideas meet.
author: Deda Stealth
description: Welcome to Inside the Fashion Cosmos, the vodcast where brands, technology, and ideas meet. Brought to you by Deda Stealth, we go behind the scenes with the world's most iconic luxury and premium fashion brands, exploring the digital architecture, AI, and supply chain strategies shaping global retail.

author: Christopher Mifsud

Live tabletop RPG actual plays, campaign-building sessions, and fantasy storytelling, hosted by Christopher Mifsud, aka The Magical Mr. Mifsud.

title: The NSRT Podcast
author: NSRT
description:
The NSRT Podcast explores the science, strategies, and real-world stories behind nervous system regulation—and how learning to regulate the body’s response to stress can improve performance, resilience, recovery, and everyday life.
Hosted by Ryan Layne, Founder of NSRT™, and Neil “The Media Giant” Haley, the podcast brings together leading experts, practitioners, first responders, veterans, healthcare professionals, executives, athletes, coaches, and other high-performing individuals for meaningful conversations about the nervous system and the role it plays in how we think, respond, recover,

title: Grant Harting: Medication Pricing & Pharmacy Truths
author: Grant Harting
description: Grant Harting is a licensed pharmacist who spent years watching patients overpay for the same drugs sold cheaper a block away. He founded CrushCost to help people cut prescription costs and now runs one of the fastest-growing pharmacy channels in the country. He tests gas station pills in labs, explains what is actually in supplements, breaks down the most expensive medications in the world, and teaches people how to use melatonin and zinc the right way. His work has made him known as America's Pharmacist. Follow the show and leave a five-star rating if you learn something that saves you money.

title: Better Tomorrow
author: Joe Stone-Lee
description: Life for young people is tough. So many issues such as unemployment, housing, climate change and the cost of living crisis will directly impact young people across the country. Yet no one seems to be solving these issues. On Better Tomorrow, in each episode student Joe Stone-Lee will explore a new topic challenging young people with an expert in the hope to find where it all went wrong for younger generations and how it can be solved to build a Better Tomorrow for young people.

title: Note to self, From me to Lee
author: lee
description:
A little bit of unwarranted advice, delusion, and a whole
lot of figuring it out as i go. 
This is where i have all sorts of life conversations with myself: random thoughts, lessons learned, mental health awareness, friendships, love interests and everything in between. 
Think of it as the conversations i wish someone had with me, and the reminders i wish i had before turning 20 
Basically these are notes to myself, from myself to Lee. If you relate then you’re definitely in the right place. If not, well… sucks to be you.💋

title: The Follow Through: Where Sunday Meets Monday
author: Fission Student Ministry at Rowland Road Baptist Church (RRBC)
description:
The Follow Through: Where Sunday Meets Monday
A podcast from Fission Student Ministries at Rowland Road Baptist Church.
Helping parents bring Sunday to every day. Each Monday, this 10–15 minute podcast connects your teenager’s Sunday night message and small group discussions with practical discipleship at home. Through biblical encouragement, relevant research, and simple conversation starters, we help you ENGAGE your student, EQUIP their faith, and encourage them to EXIST in the world as followers of Jesus.
You don’t need every answer to start a meaningful conversation.

title: Mondays from the Middle
author: Latosha Leonard
description: Mondays from the Middle is a weekly podcast hosted by licensed counselor and transition specialist Latosha D. Leonard, LPC. Each episode is 10–15 minutes built around one idea from the Middle of Change framework — the philosophy that the space between what ended and what hasn't started yet is a real, navigable place.  Every week includes a short teaching, a guided practice you do in the episode, and one honest reflection question to carry into the week. For women navigating life transitions, identity shifts, and the quiet disorientation that doesn't have a name yet.

title: Lore & Disorder
author: Amber | Lore & Disorder
description:
Books, games, fandoms, and whatever fictional character is currently ruining my life. Lore & Disorder is a delightfully chaotic dive into the stories we obsess over—from fantasy and romantasy to thrillers, manga, audiobooks, story-driven games, indie authors, publishing, and everything in between. Expect reviews, ridiculous tangents, behind-the-scenes adventures, occasional guests, and absolutely no guarantee that I’ll stay on topic.
If it has lore—or causes disorder—it qualifies.

title: Systems of Support
author: KoozArch
description: Systems of Support is a two-part audio series accompanying the 2026 edition of the International Architecture Biennale Rotterdam (IABR). Taking the biennale’s exploration of the systems that sustain everyday life as its starting point, the series asks how architecture can contribute to more equitable and regenerative ways of living. Moving beyond architecture as Form Follows Finance, the biennale put the emphasis on value creation. Through conversations on collective practice, material knowledge and shared learning, it considers the relationships that make building possible—and how these might support lasting social and ecological change.

description: In this podcast, Human Design business strategist Nicoline Huizinga explores business and daily life with professionals through the lens of Human Design. Every episode shares the story of strengths, hurdles, pivotal moments and unique views on life and business.

title: The Struggle Bus Ecomm Nearly News
author: The V Spot News
description:
“This is an up-at-dawn, pride-swallowing siege that I will never fully tell you about.”
 — Jerry Maguire
The Struggle Bus Podcast is a 15–18-minute weekly show made for the ecommerce, retail, and marketing tech leaders who’ve been at this a while—and know the grind never really ends. This isn’t another overproduced “How I scaled to 8 figures” podcast. This is what happens when the cameras are off, the stock is stuck in customs, the marketing budget is gone, and you still show up.
Hosted by Vinny O’Brien —a seasoned ecommerce strategist and operator.

title: Jesus Conquers
author: David Longenecker
description:
The Gospel isn't the story of a world God gives up on. It's the story of Jesus Christ, who has already won.
Explore the Bible's biggest questions about salvation, hell, the cross, Revelation, and our future with author and Bible teacher David E. Longenecker.
Our four Gospel pillars:
• UNDIVIDED — The Father is exactly like Jesus.
• HEALING — He destroys corruption, not creation.
• UNITED — Jesus entered our death and rose as our life.
• VICTORIOUS — He has conquered and is making all things new.
Honest questions. An open Bible. A Savior who has already won.

title: Finding the Merit
author: Colin Das
description:
We focus on finding the merits of what is out there. Instead of focusing on the negatives, we find the good stuff and expose and discuss that. We dive into wide ranging sources from happiness to love. 
The hosts, Colin and Fedor, are engineers and breakdancers, so they often seek to extract the mental models, make connections to dancing, and talk about video games.

title: Lets All Stay Curious
author: PJ & Sara
description: Curious minds, assemble! 🐘✨ Join Roger the Elephant and his global animal friends on Let’s All Stay Curious, the podcast where learning is pure fun. Packed with wild facts, incredible trivia, and plenty of laughs, it's the ultimate listen for kids who love to ask "Why?" Tune in and discover something amazing today!

title: Silent Key
author: ARC Productions
description:
There are things people on Cedar Key don’t talk about. Lena Allan’s father recorded them.


After his mysterious death, Lena returns to the remote island. She finds a shack full of taped broadcasts. Years of strange transmissions her father collected for reasons she has yet to understand.


Each tape gives her another piece of the father she barely knew, and another reason to question the people who knew him best.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: The Oxford Writing Career Guide
author: Oxford Writers' House
description:
What’s it like to dig into the stories behind gambling circuits or government corruption? How do authors come up with fresh ideas for gripping novels? What pushes a literary agent’s “yes” button? 


Join Oxford University student Nancy Gittus as she speaks to renowned investigative journalists, award-winning novelists, celebrated academics, and successful publishers uncovering the diverse array of paths a passion for words offers. 


A way with words opens doors. Follow Nancy to get a behind-the-scenes view of the writing life!

title: Could It Though?
author: Garry "Gazza"
description:
Could Elon Musk end world poverty? Could AI run a country? Could you buy every lottery ticket and guarantee a win? Big “what if” questions, answered with real numbers.

Each episode takes one wild hypothetical and runs it through three questions. Could it? Is it even possible? Would it? What happens when someone actually tries? Should it? And if we could, is it a good idea?

Hosted by Gazza. Real maths, real sources, short episodes and a straight verdict at the end. From stopping ageing to moving a million people to Mars, we take the questions everyone wonders about and find out whether they’d actually work.

New questions, real answers. Could it? Would it? Should it?

title: The Investors

description: Because the best return is a person. 🎙️ RAY WILLIAM JOHNSON — WHERE THE INTERNET GETS INTERESTING! 🔥
Think you’ve seen everything the internet has to offer? Think again! Welcome to a world of shocking stories, unbelievable real-life events, viral controversies, mysterious cases, and jaw-dropping moments that will leave you questioning everything.
Join Ray William Johnson as the internet’s wildest stories come to life through captivating storytelling, sharp commentary, unexpected twists, and entertaining takes on the events everyone is talking about. From unbelievable true stories and internet mysteries to viral moments that break the internet, every episode takes you deeper into the stories behind the headlines.
🔥 Expect the unexpected.
😱 Discover stories you won’t believe are real.
🌎 Explore the internet’s most fascinating moments.
🎧 Stay entertained, informed, and always curious.

Research-led discussion with AI-generated presenters; no invented hands-on tests or guaranteed results.

Richard Osman & Marina Hyde share insider knowledge on TV, movies, and pop culture.
Stay up to date on what's hot and what's not in entertainment with behind-the-scenes insights from Richard and Marina. As two of the most connected voices in the business, they provide a unique perspective on the latest television series, film releases, and cultural trends. Whether you're a fan of gritty dramas, blockbuster movies, or celebrity news, this podcast is your ultimate guide to entertainment. author: Wilf
description: The Brockmann Method is a weekly conversation about markets, momentum and a life well invested. Wilf Brockmann, a 45-year investment veteran and author of The Future of Investing Is Here and Self-Help for Billionaires, answers a host’s questions one idea at a time: why rules beat forecasts, how to manage your emotions when markets fall, and how a full life connects to a well-run portfolio. Each episode draws on his Substack essays.

title: The Whole Story
author: Samantha Stilwell
description:
The Whole Story is a living archive of women building things before we know how their stories end.
Businesses, creative projects, community initiatives, side hustles, new chapters — we record women in the middle of making them, while the decisions are still decisions and not yet lessons and we follow-up with them to see how those decisions turned out later!
These aren't success stories. They're records of uncertainty, experimentation, pivots, pauses, ordinary days and everything else that usually gets edited out.
The Whole Story is a record of women in the act of becoming.

title: 3 Guys 1 Cop
author: 3 Guys 1 Cop Productions
description:
3 Guys 1 Cop is a story-driven Dungeons & Dragons podcast where four longtime friends bring three distinct homebrew worlds to life. With rotating roles around the table, cinematic storytelling, memorable characters, and the unpredictable chaos of the dice, every campaign brings a new adventure.
Our journey begins in Egaria with *Shadows of Greenridge*. Pull up a chair, roll the dice, and join the adventure.
Three worlds. Four friends. Countless ways for things to go wrong.

title: Authorized Intelligence
author: Rubrik
description: Authorized Intelligence is for the security and technology leaders caught between unlocking the value of AI and confronting the new risks organizations are contending with both from outside and within. Host ⁠Cal Al-Dhubaib⁠, AI risk management expert at ⁠Rubrik⁠, brings you into the room with the world’s leading frontier model red teamers, CISOs, AI policymakers, and beyond to unpack the new rules of resilience in an AI powered world.

author: Strengthening Ministries Training Institute

Engineering Insights – Construction from Scratch to Finish

Join host  Engr. Abel and construction expert Green as they walk you through the complete journey of a construction project  from the first feasibility study to final handover.  

In this clear, practical episode you’ll discover:
- How designs move from paper to site  
- Foundation choices and structural sequences  
- Quality control, safety, and sustainability  
- Common pitfalls and how successful projects avoid them  

Perfect for engineering students, young professionals, and anyone who wants to understand how buildings and infrastructure are actually delivered.  

Listen now and build with knowledge.

title: Dialled
author: Joshua Lee
description:
Every business has a story worth telling.

From billion-dollar empires and ambitious entrepreneurs to unexpected success stories, we explore how the world's most fascinating businesses, brands and organisations were built.

Discover the people, decisions, rivalries and strategies behind their success, and the extraordinary stories that shaped the world of business.

Because there's a business behind everything.

title: OCBC Leading Educational Attainment (LEA) Podcast
author: Orange County Business Council
description:
The Leading Educational Attainment (LEA) Podcast helps Orange County students and families navigate education. author: Tony Moon
description:
Step onto the rooftop with Tony Moon, one of the original “Rooftop Koreans” from the 1992 LA Riots.
This is the real story. The one that never made the headlines the way it should have. Faith. Freedom. Standing up when no one else would.
Follow Tony:

Instagram → https://www.instagram.com/roofkorean7/

title: Philosophical Essence: How Reality Actually Works
author: Philosophical Essence
description:
Philosophical Essence™ is a creative media channel exploring consciousness, energy, and the deeper questions of human existence.

What started as a simple curiosity has grown - in just 17 months - into a global community of more than 600,000 people and over 34 million views.
We’re amazed and grateful every day for the people who join us on this journey.

Disclaimer: Content is for educational and entertainment purposes only. Critical thinking and independent research are encouraged.

title: The 100 Stories Project
author: Unmuted Stories
description:
The 100 Stories Project is an Unmuted Stories original podcast hosted by Tash Miller, featuring 100 honest conversations with Australian business owners, entrepreneurs, founders and everyday people.
Discover the personal stories behind business success, entrepreneurship, motherhood, grief, resilience and starting again.
Going beyond business interviews, Tash explores the defining moments, challenges and life lessons that shape who we become.
Real people. Real stories. Meaningful conversations worth remembering.

title: The Step Brothers Podcast: Hosted by The Intern
author: stepbrotherspod
description: Two stepbrothers break down NFL matchups, betting lines, and weekly picks with unfiltered banter, bold predictions, and plenty of laughs—all hosted by The Intern.

title: Path & Purpose
author: Path and Purpose
description: Path & Purpose is for the Traveler in between who they were and who they are becoming. description:
The Black Death: London in the Shadow of Death is a three-episode historical podcast exploring one of the darkest chapters in London’s history.

In the middle of the fourteenth century, an invisible enemy entered England and eventually reached London. What followed was a catastrophe unlike anything the city had experienced before. Families were separated, streets became strangely quiet, churches struggled to cope with the dead, and burial grounds filled faster than anyone could have imagined.

The series begins with the arrival of the plague in London in 1348 and explores how medieval Londoners reacted to a disease they could neither understand nor effectively treat. The second episode takes listeners into the heart of the disaster, examining the symptoms, fear, mass deaths, emergency cemeteries, and desperate attempts to find explanations and cures.

The final episode moves beyond the immediate horror to explore what happened after the worst had passed. The Black Death did not simply kill people. It changed wages, labour, social relationships, religion, and the balance of power within medieval society.

This is not only a story about death. It is also a story about fear, survival, resilience, and a city permanently changed by an invisible enemy.

- The difference between acute and chronic organ failure
- How the kidneys, liver, heart and lungs fail — causes, warning signs and treatments
- Why multiple organ dysfunction syndrome (MODS) is so dangerous

- Proven ways to reduce personal risk
- Emerging therapies and research offering new hope

Clear, compassionate and evidence-based, this episode gives patients, caregivers and health professionals a thorough understanding of a complex subject that affects millions worldwide.

Whether you're launching your first business, scaling an established company, developing your leadership skills, or looking for practical entrepreneurship insights, you'll discover thoughtful perspectives and actionable lessons to help you think more strategically and build with purpose.

title: Mildred's Boys and Girls (The Landreth Family's Journey)

description:
When the Landreth family faces the looming threat of civil war, the bonds of love and loyalty are put to the ultimate test. In "Mildred's Boys and Girls" by Martha Finley, young Mildred and her siblings navigate the tumultuous landscape of a nation divided. As their idyllic childhood is disrupted, they encounter challenges that will shape their character and beliefs for years to come.

This audiobook invites listeners into a heartfelt journey where family ties are forged in adversity and courage shines brightest in the darkest times. With each chapter, you will witness the Landreth children grapple with the uncertainties of a changing world, exploring themes of friendship, sacrifice, and the quest for justice.

Mildred's determination to keep her family united amidst the chaos reveals a powerful message about the strength found in togetherness. Each character faces personal dilemmas that reflect the societal shifts of their time, making their struggles relatable and poignant.

As you listen, you’ll be drawn into their world, eager to discover how they will confront the looming conflict and the decisions that will define their futures. "Mildred's Boys and Girls" isn't just a story about growing up; it's a vivid portrait of resilience and the enduring spirit of family in the face of hardship. Tune in and experience a tale that resonates with both heart and history.

title: A Pilgrimage (Jessie Muir Translation)
author: Johan Bojer
description:
Regina’s heart breaks as she hands over her newborn son, a decision that haunts her every day. In Johan Bojer’s poignant novel, A Pilgrimage, we delve into the emotional turmoil of a young unmarried mother in Norway, struggling against societal norms and the weight of her choices. This audiobook invites you to walk alongside Regina as she navigates the choppy waters of love, loss, and relentless longing.

Now a housekeeper for a wealthy family, Regina's life unfolds against the backdrop of a community that judges her, but her true battle lies within. Haunted by the child she never got to raise, Regina’s obsession grows, intertwining her past with her present in unexpected ways. Will she ever find peace, or will the shadows of her decisions forever loom over her?

A Pilgrimage explores deep themes of motherhood, sacrifice, and the search for identity. As Regina’s story unfolds, listeners will experience her emotional highs and lows, drawing them into a world where every choice has profound consequences. This audiobook doesn’t just share a story; it invites you on a journey through the complexities of the human heart and the enduring power of love. Discover the intricacies of Regina’s life, and feel the pull of her unresolved past, this is a tale that resonates far beyond its pages.

As the authors unveil their training routines and match experiences, they also tackle the central conflict of every athlete: balancing ambition with sportsmanship. Listeners will encounter the challenges of competition, the thrill of victory, and the sting of defeat, all while gaining insight into what it takes to be the best. From mastering the basics to understanding advanced tactics, each chapter is packed with practical advice that resonates with players at any level.

Whether you’re a seasoned player or a curious beginner, this audiobook offers an engaging mix of entertainment and education, sparking your passion for badminton and inspiring you to hit the court with renewed energy. title: Money, Love and Kate : Together with the Story of a Nickel
author: Eleanor H. Porter
description:
When John Newcomb finds himself broke and desperately seeking work, he discovers an unexpected lifeline: a promise of $30,000 waiting for him upon marriage. But for John, love means more than a financial reward. He yearns for a genuine connection, determined not to let money dictate his heart's desires. In "Money, Love and Kate Together with the Story of a Nickel," Eleanor H. Porter weaves a rich tapestry of relationships, ambition, and moral integrity, inviting listeners into a world where virtue triumphs over greed.

As John navigates the complexities of love, he encounters a colorful cast of characters, each embodying their own values and dreams. From the wise mentor who imparts life lessons to the spirited Kate, who challenges John's preconceptions about wealth and happiness, every interaction shapes his journey toward understanding what truly matters. Listeners will be captivated by the central conflict between duty and desire, as John grapples with societal expectations while pursuing his authentic self.

This audiobook offers more than just a romantic tale; it delves into themes of integrity, the true meaning of wealth, and the transformative power of love. Join John on this heartfelt journey as he discovers that sometimes, the most valuable things in life come from within. Perfect for fans of literary fiction that celebrates character growth and moral dilemmas, this story will leave you pondering the true essence of happiness long after the last word.

title: Hudson River Bracketed (A Classic Tale of Love and Society)
author: Edith Wharton
description:
When the ambitious and wealthy Martin Boyne embarks on a journey along the Hudson River, he quickly finds himself entangled in a web of societal expectations and romantic intrigue. In Edith Wharton’s 'Hudson River Bracketed,' the clash between personal desire and social obligation takes center stage, as Boyne grapples with his feelings for the enchanting but conflicted artist, the beautiful and elusive Miss Berenice. As they navigate the complexities of love, art, and the constraints of their social class, listeners will experience a rich tapestry of emotions and moral dilemmas.

Set against the backdrop of early 20th-century America, this audiobook delves into themes of identity, ambition, and the pursuit of happiness. Wharton’s sharp wit and keen observations illuminate the struggles of her characters as they confront their own aspirations and the weight of tradition. Can Boyne find a way to reconcile his dreams with the expectations of a society that demands conformity? What sacrifices will he and Berenice make in their quest for personal fulfillment?

As listeners journey through the pages of this classic, they will uncover not only the beauty of the Hudson River but also the intricate dynamics of love and societal pressures. 'Hudson River Bracketed' invites you to reflect on the choices we make and the paths we take, making it a timeless exploration of the human spirit.

description:
The go to podcast for women leaders who want to grow in their relationship with God!!
Not feeling confident in distinguishing God’s voice? Are responsibilities consuming your time and leaving you with little or not enough time for God? Is fear stopping you from doing what God is asking of you? Have you been feeling stuck and don’t know how to move forward?
Luv, I’ve been looking for you, and I am so glad you’re here.
Deep Intimacy With God is for women leaders who desire a deeper relationship with God but struggle with hearing His voice, trusting His direction, and consistently making time for Him.
Here, you’ll learn how to hear God’s voice with confidence, grow closer to Him, trust His leading, and walk in obedience—without neglecting the responsibilities and purpose He has entrusted to you.
You’ll be empowered to overcome fear, distractions, inconsistency, and overwhelm so you can stop second-guessing God, trust Him more deeply, and confidently live out your God-given purpose.
Hi luvs, I’m Shardell—a mother, entrepreneur, lover of purpose, and lover of deep intimacy with God.
As a woman who wears many hats, I know what it feels like to love God and still struggle to consistently make quality time for Him. I’ve tried doing things my way, hiding behind my responsibilities, and doing just enough to feel like I was staying connected—going to church when I could, reading a verse a day, praying when I had time, and serving when I was needed.
But instead of feeling close to God, I often felt overwhelmed, distracted, and unsure.
I kept wondering, “Am I really hearing God?”
I didn’t want to miss His voice or find myself outside His will. I wanted more than simply doing Christian things. I wanted a real relationship with God. I wanted to know His heart, recognize His voice, trust His direction, and experience the deep intimacy with God I had been longing for.
Everything began to change when I stopped trying to fit God into whatever time I had left and began creating a lifestyle that made room for Him—a lifestyle that worked with the life He had actually called me to live.
As I learned to consistently make time for God, my intimacy with Him grew. And as my intimacy grew, so did my confidence in hearing His voice, trusting His direction, and walking in obedience.
Now, I want to help other women leaders experience that same transformation.
So if you’re ready to stop striving, stop second-guessing God’s voice, and stop wondering if you’re missing God, you’re in the right place.
It’s time to create a lifestyle that makes room for God—one that helps you grow closer to Him, hear His voice with confidence, trust His leading, and faithfully walk in the purpose He has given you.
Open your ear, open your heart, and let’s grow closer to God together.

How can STEM-led organisations retain brilliant talent and create workplaces where experienced
women can thrive?
This podcast series explores *menopause in STEM* workplaces, with a focus on helping leaders
retain experienced women and build more supportive, inclusive organisations.
Across ten practical, thought-provoking episodes, explore why menopause is a business, leadership
and talent-retention issue, and what leaders can do about it.
Discover why experienced women may reduce their hours or leave, how menopause affects everyone
differently, and how to create an environment where people feel supported without having to share
more than they wish. Learn how to have respectful, confidential conversations, make meaningful
workplace adjustments and challenge stigma. With honest stories, fresh perspectives and actionable
insights, the series explores how leaders, women and men alike, can drive lasting cultural change.
Designed especially for *women in STEM leadership* , this series will equip you to turn awareness into
action, support your people and help retain the experience and expertise STEM needs.
*THIS Kind of Menopause* is all about feeling informed, prepared and empowered to have the kind of
menopause that’s seen as the next chapter of life, not a burden, something to dread, or a career
limiting life stage. It’s also a time to be kind to ourselves and that starts with talking about our
experiences and learning to advocate for ourselves.
Combining workplace guidance, statistics and personal stories, the series’ central message is that
menopause does not make women less capable. With greater awareness, better conversations and
thoughtful support, STEM organisations can retain valuable expertise and enable women to continue
thriving throughout their careers.
*Press play and discover how leadership can make a difference.*
*About Rebecca Cooper*
﻿Rebecca Cooper is a certified menopause coach and corporate menopause trainer with 20 years of
experience in HR. With first-hand experience of an early menopause, she is committed to enabling
STEM-led organisations retain experienced talent by creating menopause-inclusive workplaces.
Through menopause awareness training, leadership development, policy guidance and coaching
Rebecca supports individuals and organisations navigate the menopause transition with honesty,
practical support and kindness.

description: Caring Directly is a podcast that features the patients of Direct Primary Care physicians.You may be wondering what is a Direct Primary Care physician and so let me paint a picture for you.Before medicine became dominated by non-physicians, a doctor was able to directly care for their patient.
